item.title: 'Starlink would help the least served in India, especially in rural areas': Elon Musk
item.summary: Elon Musk supports Starlink's satellite internet for India's underserved rural communities. The service aims to bridge significant connectivity gaps where 4G access remains limited. Starlink's network could reach remote areas, overcoming terrain and infrastructure challenges. The Indian government is developing regulatory frameworks for satellite spectrum allocation. Starlink remains in active discussions with the Centre regarding its commercial launch.
